cohort: The study included 54 neonates whose placentas were diagnosed with Fetal Vascular Malperfusion (FVM) and 56 control neonates.
finding: Fetal vascular malperfusion (FVM) was significantly associated with lower gestational age, birth weight, and placental weight, along with a higher frequency of IUGR, poor neonatal survival, and various neonatal morbidities including neurological abnormalities, sepsis, and asphyxia.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome, with lower mean birth weight observed in the FVM group.
gest_age: Measured as an outcome, with lower mean gestational age observed in the FVM group.
